newsitem.title: DENMARK: General Electric reduces ISS stake.
newsitem.headline: General Electric reduces ISS stake.

text.p: U.S. group General Electric Corporation said Thursday that it had reduced its holdings in Denmark's ISS A/S from 6.46 of total share capital to 4.91 percent between July 1994 and June 1996.
The announcement, obligatory under Copenhagen Stock Exchange regulations, gave no reason.
In May 1996 ISS acknowledged major accounting flaws in its U.S. unit that it said could wipe $100 million off the books.

On August 15 it reported a first-half loss of $354 million and upped provisions by a further $47 million, then two weeks later said it had sold the U.S firm, for an undisclosed sum. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
